title: CivilBench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Information Integration in Civil Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2611.21105v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support. However, the extent to which current VLMs possess the reasoning capabilities required for reliable engineering judgments remains unclear. In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios. CivilBench covers three major task families: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, encompassing numerical reasoning, structural damage assessment, risk inference, causal analysis, and repair planning. The benchmark is constructed through a systematic pipeline of domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, expert annotation, question design, and quality

translated_title: CivilBench：面向土木工程中多模态信息集成的视觉-语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI），特别是大语言模型（LLM）和视觉-语言模型（VLM），正日益应用于土木与结构工程领域，用于灾害评估、结构分析和工程决策支持。然而，当前VLM在多大程度上具备可靠工程判断所需的推理能力仍不明确。在本工作中，我们提出了CivilBench，这是一个用于评估VLM在土木工程及灾害相关场景中表现的综合基准。CivilBench涵盖三大任务族：序列推理、基于图像的结构理解和开放世界理解，包含数值推理、结构损伤评估、风险推断、因果分析以及修复规划等任务。该基准通过一个系统性流程构建，包括领域特定数据收集、面向工程的图像描述生成、专家标注、问题设计以及质量……
tldr: 本文提出CivilBench——首个面向土木工程与灾害场景的综合视觉-语言模型基准，涵盖序列推理、图像结构理解与开放世界理解三大任务族，系统评估了VLM在工程可靠判断中所需的多模态推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates vision-language models' multimodal reasoning capabilities for reliable engineering judgment in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios, covering sequential reasoning, image-based structural understanding, and open-world understanding tasks.
